title.zh: Bitget Hacked as $350 Million Vanishes From Crypto Exchange Wallets
title.en: Bitget Hacked as $350 Million Vanishes From Crypto Exchange Wallets

current_state.zh: Bitget 在热钱包被盗后已暂停提现，称受影响金额为 3.516 亿美元，冷钱包未受影响，事件由其超过 4.64 亿美元的用户保护基金覆盖。
current_state.en: Bitget has suspended withdrawals following a hot wallet breach, saying $351.6 million was affected, cold wallets were unaffected, and the incident is covered by its more than $464 million user protection fund.

updates.title_zh: Bitget Hacked as $350 Million Vanishes From Crypto Exchange Wallets
updates.title_en: Bitget Hacked as $350 Million Vanishes From Crypto Exchange Wallets
updates.what_changed_zh: Bitget confirmed a hack in which roughly $350 million in crypto was drained from its hot wallets, with on-chain data showing about $183 million in ETH, USDT, USDC, AVAX and BNB moved to a single address and a fresh wallet spending $19.67M in USDT0 to buy 7,111 ETH on Arbitrum, while the CEO said cold wallets stayed secure and losses are covered by the exchange's $464M User Protection Fund.

updates.title_zh: Bitget Suspends Withdrawals, Says $351.6 Million Affected In Hot Wallet Breach
updates.title_en: Bitget Suspends Withdrawals, Says $351.6 Million Affected In Hot Wallet Breach
updates.what_changed_zh: Bitget 已暂停提现，并披露此次热钱包被盗影响金额为 3.516 亿美元。
updates.what_changed_en: Bitget suspended withdrawals and disclosed that the hot wallet breach affected $351.6 million.
updates.current_state_zh: Bitget 在热钱包被盗后已暂停提现，称受影响金额为 3.516 亿美元，冷钱包未受影响，事件由其超过 4.64 亿美元的用户保护基金覆盖。
updates.current_state_en: Bitget has suspended withdrawals following a hot wallet breach, saying $351.6 million was affected, cold wallets were unaffected, and the incident is covered by its more than $464 million user protection fund.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Bitget suspended withdrawals after disclosing a hot wallet breach in which $351.6 million was affected, stating cold wallets were untouched and that the incident is covered by its user protection fund holding over $464 million.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Bitget suspended withdrawals after disclosing a hot wallet breach in which $351.6 million was affected, stating cold wallets were untouched and that the incident is covered by its user protection fund holding over $464 million.
updates.background_zh: Bitget 总部位于塞舌尔维多利亚，成立于 2018 年，按 CoinGecko 数据为第六大交易所，日交易量超过 11 亿美元。此次事件发生在该交易所本月启动的八周年活动期间，其正从加密业务扩展至股票和外汇领域。这也是 2026 年一系列事件中的最新一起：7 月，黑客利用比特币硬件钱包 Coldcard 的固件漏洞窃取近 1.2 亿美元；本月，自称白帽的黑客从 Blockstream 的 Liquid 侧链联邦钱包中提取了约 4,000 枚比特币，当时价值约 3.2 亿美元。报道称，此次事件使 9 月的加密盗窃金额超过 4 月，成为 2026 年迄今黑客攻击损失最高的月份。
updates.background_en: Victoria, Seychelles-based Bitget was founded in 2018 and is the sixth-largest exchange, processing over $1.1 billion in daily trading volume according to CoinGecko. The breach occurred during the exchange's eighth-anniversary campaign, which it launched this month as it expands beyond crypto into equities and foreign exchange. It adds to a string of 2026 incidents: in July, hackers exploited a firmware bug in the Coldcard bitcoin hardware wallet to steal nearly $120 million, and this month purported white-hat hackers withdrew about 4,000 bitcoins, worth roughly $320 million at the time, from Blockstream's Liquid sidechain federation wallet. The report says the breach pushes September crypto thefts above April, making it the costliest month for hacks so far in 2026.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次事件直接冲击 Bitget 热钱包与温钱包的流动性，全平台暂停提现则切断了这家日交易量超 11 亿美元的六大交易所用户的赎回通道。被转出的资产（其中包含稳定币和比特币）以及尚未查明的攻击路径，是这一事件向更广泛的交易所流动性与托管风险情绪传导的渠道。
updates.market_impact_en: The hit lands on Bitget's hot and warm wallet liquidity, and the platform-wide withdrawal freeze directly affects the redemption channel for users of a top-six venue handling over $1.1 billion in daily volume. The assets named in the transfers — stablecoins and bitcoin among them — plus the still-unknown attack vector, are the channels through which the incident can feed into broader exchange-liquidity and custody-risk sentiment.
